newsitem.title: CHINA: HSBC moves Shanghai office. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: HSBC moves Shanghai office. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects title from "...moves to Pudong for yuan business")
The Hong Kong & Shanghai Banking Corp opened its new Shanghai branch in the Pudong New Area on Friday, a bank official said.
(Corrects to delete reference to local currency business)
The bank becomes the third foreign bank to move its branch office to Pudong from central Shanghai after Citibank of the United States and Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd of Japan.
The banks are amongst eight foreign banks approved to handle local currency business. But a pre-condition is that they have to move their main Shanghai branch to Pudong.
Foreign bankers say they expect local currency business transactions to begin in early April.
